shared_elements: low-relief carving of forms against a plain ground
repeated identical motifs in ordered sequence
rosette-like circular element (rosettes in the lower border band of A; rosette-flowers in B)
dense patterned infill of surface texture (fleece scales / leaf clusters)
justification: A depicts a narrative procession of bearded human figures leading horned rams in profile, while B is a purely vegetal all-over pattern of stylised palmette/rosette blossoms on interlacing stems with no figures or animals at all; the only real correspondences are the shallow relief technique, the taste for dense repeated ornament, and small rosette-like discs (in A's basal border, in B's flower heads). There is no shared relationship or scene, so the similarity is generic rather than iconographic.
